# Dark mode toggle (community, Node only)

Adds a floating light/dark switch (`<dark-mode-toggle>`, `role: injected`) to published pages. The default scheme and position are baked in as attributes at render, so the client never reads server settings. The visitor's choice stays in their browser.

It appears only on themes whose registry entry lists both `light` and `dark` in `colorSchemes`, read through `ctx.registries.theme()`. A dark-only theme such as neon-glow-theme gets no toggle.

<!-- implements:start (generated by scripts/plugin-docs.mjs from plugin.yaml and the docblocks in the code; do not edit by hand) -->
## What it implements

| Kind | Name | Runs when | What this plugin does |
|---|---|---|---|
| hook | `render.after.body` | right before the closing body tag | Adds the dark-mode-toggle element and its script to the end of the body, only when the active theme supports both light and dark schemes. |
| element | `dark-mode-toggle` | injected |  |

Each code row matches a docblock (`Implements hook ...`, `Implements operation ...`) directly above the implementation in `src/nodejs`.
